Task complete. Summary:

1. **Management fee (JE-00305)** — Recorded UK's side of the March IC management fee: Dr 6550 Intercompany Management Fees / Cr 2300 Intercompany Payable, GBP 12,000.00 (USD 15,000 ÷ 1.2500 policy rate), supported by the IC invoice (DOC-0206) and Treasury FX rates (DOC-0201). Since the USD-equivalent ($15,000) exceeds the $10,000 senior-accountant threshold, I submitted it for controller approval per policy — it's now pending.

2. **Loan remeasurement (JE-00306)** — Remeasured the USD 200,000 IC loan payable from GBP 157,480.31 (at 1.2700) to GBP 160,000.00 (at the 1.2500 March policy rate), booking a GBP 2,519.69 FX loss, supported by the loan agreement (DOC-0016) and FX rates (DOC-0201). Below the approval threshold, so posted directly with no further routing needed.

Both entries are fully supported per policy; no exceptions were needed.
